title: Simplify dashboard with placeholder values and add admin reset feature

requirements.summary: Update Dashboard page to display placeholder values for all usage statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays 0 or clean placeholder values for all usage metrics
No incorrect or inflated numbers like 9114 appear
All quota fields show placeholder values indicating the tracking system is not yet implemented
UI remains visually consistent and professional with placeholder data

file_operations.description: Replace all usage statistics calculations with placeholder values (0 or sensible defaults). Update the following metrics to show placeholders: Usage This Week (0), Tools Used This Week (0), Total Usage (0), Saved Tools (0), Daily Quota remaining (10 of 10), daily uses (0), Weekly Quota remaining (50 of 50), weekly uses (0), Today's Usage (0), and Average Daily (0). Remove or simplify any logic that fetches or calculates incorrect values. Ensure all UI elements display cleanly with these placeholder values.

requirements.summary: Create admin panel page for resetting user usage statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a new 'Reset User Stats' page
Admin can select a user from a list or search
A reset button clears all usage counts for the selected user
Confirmation dialog appears before resetting to prevent accidental data loss
Success message confirms the reset operation completed

file_operations.description: Create a new admin page wrapped in AdminAuthGuard for resetting user usage statistics. The page should: (1) Display a list or search interface for selecting users by Principal ID, (2) Show a 'Reset Statistics' button that triggers a confirmation dialog, (3) Call the backend resetUserUsage method when confirmed, (4) Display success/error messages using toast or alert components, (5) Include a description explaining that this will reset all usage counts (daily usage, weekly usage, total usage, saved tools count) to zero. Use React Query's useMutation for the reset operation and invalidate relevant queries on success.

Add a new mutation hook useResetUserUsage that calls actor.resetUserUsage(userId: Principal). Configure the mutation to invalidate user-related queries (toolUsageRecords, usageStats) on success. Return the mutation function and loading/error states for use in the admin reset page.

Add a new lazy-loaded route for the admin reset user stats page at path '/admin/reset-user-stats'. Register the route in the router configuration alongside other admin routes (dashboard, blog-management, forum-moderation, etc.). Ensure the route is properly integrated with the existing admin navigation structure.

Add a new navigation card or link in the admin dashboard management section for 'Reset User Statistics'. Place it alongside existing management links (Users, Blog Posts, Forum Threads, Analytics, Settings). The link should navigate to '/admin/reset-user-stats' and include an appropriate icon (e.g., RefreshCw or RotateCcw from Lucide) and description text.
